name: heaven-furniture-mart
description: Static site. This file adds NO build step — it exists so Node resolves the site's .js files as the ES modules they already are. Without it, `.js` loads as CommonJS and importing data/pieces.js throws on its first `export`, which is why every _ref/verify-*.mjs script had to copy the modules into a temp dir with .mjs extensions first. Nothing here ships: the host serves static files and never reads package.json.
